evidence.text: Quick Answer: Recommended nominal wall thickness for injection molded plastics ranges between 1.5mm and 3.0mm (0.060 in – 0.120 in). Maintaining uniform wall thickness prevents internal void formation, sink marks, and differential cooling warpage. Rib thickness should never exceed 50% to 60% of the attached main wall thickness to avoid surface depressions.

claims.text: Quick Answer: Recommended nominal wall thickness for injection molded plastics ranges between 1.5mm and 3.0mm (0.060 in – 0.120 in). Maintaining uniform wall thickness prevents internal void formation, sink marks, and differential cooling warpage. Rib thickness should never exceed 50% to 60% of the attached main wall thickness to avoid surface depressions.

supportingEvidence.text: Quick Answer: Recommended nominal wall thickness for injection molded plastics ranges between 1.5mm and 3.0mm (0.060 in – 0.120 in). Maintaining uniform wall thickness prevents internal void formation, sink marks, and differential cooling warpage. Rib thickness should never exceed 50% to 60% of the attached main wall thickness to avoid surface depressions.
<div class="overflow-x-auto">
Moderate (Stress Voids)
Transitions between thick and thin sections must feature gradual tapers (minimum 3:1 chamfer ratio). Sudden wall thickness changes cause uneven flow fronts and severe warpage.
Avoid sharp 90-degree internal corners. Provide an internal radius of at least 50% of the nominal wall thickness to reduce stress concentration factors from 3.0 down to 1.5.

Plastic Injection Molding Nominal

Quick Answer: Recommended nominal wall thickness for injection molded plastics ranges between 1.5mm and 3.0mm (0.060 in – 0.120 in). Maintaining uniform wall thickness prevents internal void formation, sink marks, and differential cooling warpage. Rib thickness should never exceed 50% to 60% of the attached main wall thickness to avoid surface depressions.

"headline": "Injection Molding Wall Thickness and Rib Design DFM Guidelines",
"name": "NEXMOLD Precision Manufacturing"
Plastic Injection Molding Nominal

Quick Answer: Recommended nominal wall thickness for injection molded plastics ranges between 1.5mm and 3.0mm (0.060 in – 0.120 in). Maintaining uniform wall thickness prevents internal void formation, sink marks, and differential cooling warpage. Rib thickness should never exceed 50% to 60% of the attached main wall thickness to avoid surface depressions.
